name: healthcare-agents
description: US healthcare administration workups, specialist guidance, and a local workflow builder.

interface.shortDescription: Evidence-backed drafts for US healthcare administration.
interface.longDescription: Turn a healthcare administration question into a reviewable draft. Route to a workflow or specialist, tie key findings to dated evidence, and identify decisions for the accountable owner. Six workflows include local calculations with evidence checks. Build a local workflow when the existing catalog falls short.
defaultPrompt: Use Healthcare Agents to draft a prior authorization appeal evidence map. Show which notice and policy control the deadline, what is missing, and who should review the packet.
Use Healthcare Agents to investigate a denial spike. Show the claim counts behind both rates, the strongest competing explanations, and the evidence needed to resolve them.
Use Healthcare Agents to draft a HIPAA evidence checklist for a vendor review. Map each control to the artifact, owner, and check needed to verify it.
